jobs.convention_source: Llama Scope paper arXiv:2410.20526: normalization is dataset-wise, S_in = sqrt(D)/E[||x_in||_2] (a single constant); "a <beginoftext> token is prepended to the start of every document. Native hyperparams.json in provenance/release_configs confirms norm_activation='dataset-wise'.
jobs.evaluation_interpretation: Release's documented token population and space, measured under our common protocol (corpus, context and PC1 calibration are ours).

jobs.convention_source: Release config in provenance/release_configs (OpenAI GPT-2 v5 via SAE Lens): normalize_activations='layer_norm' (per-token), context_size=64, prepend_bos=False. Per-token normalization changes PC1 dominance, so the SAE input space is the space the release evaluates in.
jobs.evaluation_interpretation: Release's documented token population and space, measured under our common protocol (corpus, context and PC1 calibration are ours). The release's documented context is 64; ctx128 is the common protocol and ctx64/512 are reported as sensitivity.
